# Format: '@<table> view=<left view> view2=<right view> page=<left page> year=<exercice>', 'cols:', then
# '= <commune heading as printed>' and rows '<date of the loan as printed> | values', 'Totaux | ...' per commune.
# Money: francs with centimes after '.', no thousands separator; printed » = 0; '?' = illegible;
# durations in years ("ans"); interest rate in percent ("3 75" = 3.75, "3 1/2" = 3.5).
